title: Nucor Reports Results for the First Quarter of 2026
summary: Nucor Corporation (NYSE: NUE) today announced consolidated net earnings attributable to Nucor stockholders of $743 million, or $3.23 per diluted share, for the first quarter of 2026. Nucor reported consolidated net earnings attributable to Nucor stockholders in the fourth quarter of 2025 of $378 million, or $1.64 per diluted share (adjusted net earnings of $400 million, or $1.73 per diluted share). Nucor reported net earnings attributable to Nucor stockholders in the first quarter of 2025 of $156 million, or $0.67 per diluted share (adjusted net earnings of $179 million, or $0.77 per diluted share). "Nucor teammates delivered a strong start to 2026, with our steel mills segment achieving a new quarterly shipment record," said Leon Topalian, Nucor's Chair and Chief Executive Officer.
